name: InfluencerSoft
description_en:
InfluencerSoft combines visual sales funnels with contact lists, email and order-related automation. The relevant question is whether a business wants those activities in one funnel workspace: its documented automation can react to a subscription, tag, order or course event rather than just send a scheduled newsletter.

The public guides describe several objects with similar names, including list email series, visual sequences, general processes and processes embedded in a funnel. Evaluating them separately matters because their entry rules, timing and visibility differ. Much of the procedural material dates from 2020–2021; the findings are documentation research, not confirmation that an account currently exposes every described control.
description_zh:
InfluencerSoft 将可视化销售漏斗与联系人列表、邮件及订单相关自动化结合。关键问题是业务是否希望在同一漏斗工作区完成这些活动：其文档中的自动化可响应订阅、标签、订单或课程事件，而不只是定时发送简报。

公开指南描述了几个名称相近的对象，包括列表邮件系列、可视化序列、通用流程和嵌入漏斗的流程。应分别评估，因为它们的入口、计时和可见范围不同。大量操作资料来自 2020–2021 年；以下属于文档研究，并未确认当前账户具备每项所述控制。

core_features.explanation_en: General processes support contact, list and order events.
core_features.explanation_zh: 通用流程支持联系人、列表及订单事件。

core_features.explanation_en: Series emails use intervals measured from subscription.
core_features.explanation_zh: 系列邮件以订阅时间为间隔基点。

core_features.explanation_en: Rules can change tags, lists and custom fields.
core_features.explanation_zh: 规则可修改标签、列表及自定义字段。

core_features.explanation_en: A funnel can contain its own process block.
core_features.explanation_zh: 漏斗可包含自己的流程块。

en: Editorial fit: a course or digital-product operator connecting list entry, purchase events and follow-up.
Editorial fit: a funnel marketer willing to verify the differences between list sequences and embedded processes.
zh: 编辑判断的适用场景：连接列表加入、购买事件和后续跟进的课程或数字产品运营人员。
编辑判断的适用场景：愿意核实列表序列与嵌入流程差异的漏斗营销人员。
use_cases.basis: Editorial workflow examples; not observed customer outcomes.

steps.en: Select one internal event and a deliberate re-entry policy.
steps.zh: 选择一个内部事件及明确的重入规则。

steps.en: Confirm the corporate-domain sender and test the intended timing with internal addresses.
steps.zh: 确认企业域名发件人，用内部地址测试预期计时。

steps.en: Inspect every branch’s completion and unfinished-session edit behavior.
steps.zh: 检查每条分支的结束及修改时未完成会话的处理。

steps.en: Confirm the exact purchased tier and current offer before expanding the pilot.
steps.zh: 扩大试点前确认实际购买档位及当前优惠。

items.en: Core process and series guides date from 2020–2021; current behavior and pause/resume clocks were not exercised.
items.zh: 核心流程与系列指南来自 2020–2021 年；未操作验证当前行为或暂停／恢复时钟。

items.en: A sequence’s deletion removes its information according to the guide; the documentation does not establish recovery or message recall.
items.zh: 指南称删除序列会移除其信息；文档未确认恢复或消息撤回能力。

items.en: The sender article’s inactive-contact cleaning prose is ambiguous; a precise automatic-deletion threshold is not asserted.
items.zh: 发件设置文章对不活跃联系人清理的文字存在歧义，不断言准确的自动删除阈值。

pricing.source_snapshot_en: Observed cards: Starter $37/month or $355/year; Professional $97/month or $931/year; Influencer $177/month or $1,699/year. Funnel limits are 3, 5 and unlimited; tracked funnel events/visitors are 10k, 100k and 1m. Cards list unlimited contacts, but email automation appears on Professional and above, not Starter. Enterprise requires inquiry. Checkout, taxes and overage terms were not verified; no normalized quote assigned.
pricing.source_snapshot_zh: 实读套餐卡：Starter 每月 37 美元或每年 355 美元；Professional 每月 97 美元或每年 931 美元；Influencer 每月 177 美元或每年 1,699 美元。漏斗数分别为 3、5 和无限，跟踪漏斗事件／访客为 1 万、10 万和 100 万。卡片列无限联系人，但邮件自动化明确列在 Professional 及以上，Starter 未列。Enterprise 需咨询。未验证结账、税费或超额条款，不生成标准化报价。

review_notes: Original English and corresponding Chinese research draft. Vendor statements describe documented behavior, not independently measured quality.
Existing third-party source is discovery-only and superseded. Unknown UI languages, regional availability and licensing remain unknown.
All publication and alternative-relationship states remain unapproved.

sections.title_en: Choose re-entry before wiring an order event
sections.title_zh: 连接订单事件前先选择重入规则
sections.en: The Processes guide distinguishes once per contact, repeated concurrent runs, and repeated runs only when no session is already active. Once applies across the process’s triggers. As an editorial example, a course follow-up that should not overlap needs the nonconcurrent option; a second order arriving during the first run then needs a separately designed handling policy. Test that case rather than assuming every new order creates another active journey.
sections.zh: Processes 指南区分每位联系人仅一次、可并发重复，以及没有活动会话时才可重复。仅一次规则跨流程入口生效。编辑示例：不应重叠的课程跟进需要非并发选项；首轮期间到来的第二张订单，则需要另行设计处理规则。应测试该情形，不能假设每张新订单都会产生新的活动旅程。

sections.title_en: Manual admission and explicit completion affect behavior
sections.title_zh: 手动加入与明确结束会影响行为
sections.en: The editor documents a default manual-entry trigger alongside OR-connected event triggers. An internal evaluation should therefore check manual admission as well as event qualification. Each branch needs an End of process action: otherwise the contact remains unfinished and cannot re-enter a nonconcurrent process. Editing a live process also asks how to handle unfinished sessions. Use an isolated cohort to inspect branch counts, completion and the chosen session treatment before changing a populated process.
sections.zh: 编辑器记录了默认手动加入入口，以及按 OR 逻辑连接的事件入口。因此内部评估应同时检查手动加入和事件资格。每条分支都需要 End of process 动作，否则联系人保持未完成状态，无法重入非并发流程。修改运行中的流程还需选择未完成会话的处理方式。修改已有大量联系人的流程前，应以隔离群体检查分支计数、完成情况及所选会话处理。

sections.title_en: A series interval is not the previous-step delay
sections.title_zh: 系列间隔并非上一步延迟
sections.en: The older email-series article measures the interval from joining the list, not from the previous email. It also describes day/time restrictions in Moscow time rather than recipient time, plus exclusions that skip a particular message. Do not apply these rules automatically to visual process actions. For a hypothetical three-message onboarding series, calculate each desired send from subscription and verify the account’s actual timezone and exclusion result using internal addresses.
sections.zh: 较旧的邮件系列文章从加入列表时刻计算间隔，而非上一封邮件。它还描述按莫斯科时间、而非收件人时间设置日期／时段限制，以及仅跳过特定邮件的排除设置。不能自动把这些规则套用到可视化流程动作。假设建立三封入门系列，应从订阅时刻计算各次预期发送，并用内部地址核实账户实际时区及排除结果。

sections.title_en: Find the process in the workspace that owns it
sections.title_zh: 在所属工作区查找流程
sections.en: The sequence guide describes a process whose single starting trigger is subscription to its chosen list; that trigger cannot be edited or removed. Separately, the funnel editor says a process created inside a funnel is visible through that funnel rather than the general process page or contact-card process list. It can start through a connected block or its own trigger, and follows the funnel’s on/off state. These distinctions matter when diagnosing a missing flow or an unexpected entry.
sections.zh: 序列指南描述的是一种以所选列表订阅为唯一起始入口的流程，该入口不能编辑或删除。另一方面，漏斗编辑器说明，在漏斗内创建的流程通过该漏斗访问，不显示在通用流程页或联系人卡片流程列表中。它可由连接的模块或自身事件入口启动，并跟随漏斗启停状态。这些差异会影响流程缺失或意外加入的排查。

sections.title_en: Confirm the sender before testing an integration
sections.title_zh: 测试集成前先确认发件身份
sections.en: The 2025 mailing-settings guide requires a confirmed sender address on a corporate domain and checks DMARC compliance; an unconfirmed address cannot be selected for messages. Rules separately document an HTTPS POST/GET action to a service or script. That is not evidence of signed delivery, retries or exactly-once execution. In an evaluation, use a test mailbox and a controlled endpoint, record the received event, and investigate duplicate or missing calls before connecting a consequential action.
sections.zh: 2025 年邮件设置指南要求使用已确认的企业域名发件地址，并检查 DMARC；未确认地址不能被选作消息发件人。规则另有通过 HTTPS POST／GET 调用服务或脚本的动作，但这不能证明签名投递、重试或恰好执行一次。评估时应使用测试邮箱及受控端点，记录实际收到的事件，连接重要动作前先调查重复或缺失调用。

sections.title_en: Read the current card separately from legacy offers
sections.title_zh: 当前套餐卡与历史优惠需分别阅读
sections.en: The public pricing page mixes tier cards with lifetime testimonials and a FAQ containing June 2021 grandfathered-offer language. Its $1 trial wording does not establish a permanent free plan, and unlimited contacts does not establish unlimited email volume. Treat old promises of future upgrades or no extra fees as offer-specific until confirmed. The current checkout, precise event-counting rule and applicable sending charges remain unresolved.
sections.zh: 公开定价页混有套餐卡、终身优惠评价及包含 2021 年 6 月老用户优惠措辞的 FAQ。1 美元试用文案不能确认永久免费套餐，无限联系人也不能确认无限发信量。旧版未来升级或无额外费用承诺，在确认前应视为特定优惠内容。当前结账、事件计数规则及适用发信费用仍未解决。

seo.title_zh: InfluencerSoft：漏斗自动化、序列与套餐边界

seo.description_zh: 研究 InfluencerSoft 流程重入、明确结束、列表邮件计时及当前套餐与历史优惠边界。
seo.primary_intent: Evaluate InfluencerSoft funnel and email automation behavior
seo.query_basis: Editorial intent; no search volume, ranking or AI visibility measured.
